dialogue.user: Hi! I'm looking for a new pair of shoes. I specifically need something suitable for outdoor activities. dialogue.user: The Twisted X boots sound interesting, but the KEEN sandal description mentions "Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid," which doesn't sound like it would be for me. Can you tell me more about the **Twisted X Women's 9" All Around Work Boot - Versatile Women's Western Work Boots - Distressed Saddle, Water Resistant Oiled Leather Shaft, Made for Barn Use**? What makes them good for outdoor activities, and what are people saying in those 8 reviews?
dialogue.agent:
The "**Twisted X Women's 9" All Around Work Boot - Versatile Women's Western Work Boots - Distressed Saddle, Water Resistant Oiled Leather Shaft, Made for Barn Use**" are made from 100% leather and are designed for outdoor activities like barn work, gardening, and fence fixing. They feature a water-resistant oiled leather shaft, taped interior seams, and a moisture-wicking removable insole. For stability, they have an XSD one-piece insole with an injection composite X shank and a full-length compression-molded EVA midsole. The molded rubber outsole is also slip-resistant and durable.

Customers have found them to be comfortable and stylish, with one review mentioning they are "warm, comfy, and cute!!" and "not clunky at all." Another happy customer stated they can "work all day in them!" However, one reviewer found them to be "too narrow at the ankle" to get their foot in, and another noted they run "a little small for the size."
